name: Tápiógyörgye (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of yellow, blue and yellow in the ratio 1:1:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Tápiógyörgye (a blue and yellow shield with two white figures) below the name TÁPIÓGYÖRGYE in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
